form.title: Education Credits (American Opportunity and Lifetime Learning Credits)
form.notes: refundable: mixed — and this form is the clearest case in the map of why refundability matters. Part I produces the REFUNDABLE American opportunity credit, 40% of the allowable AOC, and line 8 goes straight to Form 1040 line 29 in the payments block. Part II produces the NONREFUNDABLE lifetime learning credit and the nonrefundable remainder of the AOC, and line 19 goes to Schedule 3 line 3 inside the tax computation. One form, two destinations, two kinds of credit. 2025 parameters read off the form's own face: AOC adjusted qualified education expenses capped at $4,000 (line 27); LLC expenses capped at $10,000 at 20% (lines 11 and 12); phase-out begins at $180,000 MFJ / $90,000 single, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse (lines 2 and 13) over a range of $20,000 / $10,000 (lines 5 and 16). Printed revision: Form 8863 (2025), Created 9/23/25.
